snippet.title: Bash Moto - Alpha development updates
snippet.description: Rider helmets can now be colored different from the suit. Corrected texture mipmap settings, more audio effects, and stopped using Fraps to record gameplay which was blowing out colors. There's some audio clipping and pathing issues I still need to look into. There's a few frame stutters which is mainly coming from recording. #indiegamedev #indiegame
